snippet.title: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO –Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch & Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO is coming to Nintendo Switch & Nintendo Switch 2 Nov. 14, 2025! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/dragon-ball-sparking-zero-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Dragon Ball: Sparking! ZERO features the largest roster in franchise history with over 180 playable characters. Players can relive iconic moments in Episode Battle, create dream scenarios in Custom Battle, and take on friends in a variety of Versus modes. 

Developed by Spike Chunsoft, Dragon Ball: Sparking! ZERO is the next evolution of the beloved Budokai Tenkaichi series. 

#DRAGONBALLSparkingZERO #NintendoSwitch #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
